title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go, parity and v1.47.0 bumps
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Unify auth/retries behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; parity fixes and version bumps to v1.47.0 for all SDKs. Minor API additions are backward-compatible; see migration notes for auth config.
description: Unify SDK behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go: this PR harmonizes auth handling, retry/backoff semantics, and the streaming API ergonomics to reach parity across official SDKs and prepares simultaneous v1.47.0 releases. Motivation: inconsistent auth header refresh behavior and slightly different streaming APIs caused developer confusion and support tickets (SUP-1023). Changes were implemented to match the reference spec (sdk-auth-spec v2) and to provide consistent retry/backoff defaults and convenient streaming helpers. High-level summary: consolidated auth adapter surface, unifies retry policy defaults and backoff computation, adds ergonomic stream iterators/async iterables parity, small API surface improvements for better type inference, and bump package versions to v1.47.0. Includes updated docs and migration notes. Checklist: [x] unify auth adapter and refresh semantics, [x] centralize retry/backoff logic, [x] unify streaming interfaces (sync/async parity), [x] tests added/updated across SDKs, [x] docs and CHANGELOG updated, [x] coordinated release PRs for packaging.
commit_summaries: refactor(auth): introduce unified AuthAdapter with token refresh hook across SDKs
feat(retries): centralize ExponentialBackoff + jitter and expose configuration at client init
feat(streaming): add AsyncStreamIterator (TS/Go shim) and StreamingResponse iterator for Python
fix(parity): align TypeScript field names and Go enum variants with Python SDK
chore(release): bump SDK versions to v1.47.0 and update changelogs

ci_details: unit: go — pass (rerun after timeout increase)
migration_notes: Auth: most users will not need to change calls; if you passed custom token refresh hooks, switch to the new AuthAdapter interface (examples in docs). Retries: retry config moved to client.init under 'retry' key; default backoff/jitter updated to be more conservative, opt-in to previous aggressive behavior via 'retry.legacyMode=true'. Streaming: new AsyncStreamIterator provides consistent chunk shapes (see streaming-ergonomics.md).
release_notes_short: v1.47.0 SDKs: unified auth/retries/streaming parity across Python/TS/Go, bug fixes, docs.
notes: Coordinated release window requested with platform release on 2026-02-28 to minimize breaking changes for dedicated customers.
No opt-in flags required for standard customers; legacy retry mode available.
